summary: Bound client message-send confirmation to three seconds, with one pending worker per idempotency key

replay.detail: No replay or projection change. This only bounds how long a client waits to learn a send's outcome; it does not shorten any writer hold.

schema.detail: No table, index, trigger or schema version change.

rules.detail: No claim admission, checkpoint or retention rule change.

compatibility.detail: Client-v0 message.send answers within three seconds of admission. If the send is not yet confirmed it returns HTTP 503 message-send-unconfirmed, retryable:false, details {applied:"unknown", action_id, idempotency_key}. The send can still finish; resending the identical request with the same key returns the original durable receipt and never sends twice. A retry whose key is already pending waits within the same deadline without taking another worker. At sixteen pending send workers a new send gets the existing rate-limited code with applied:"none" before submission. Other actions are unchanged. No generated contract change. A client without the mapping sees an unknown error code; one that retries under a new key can send twice.

manual.detail: No data repair or configuration change.

recovery.detail: An unconfirmed send is not rolled back or rejected. Recover its outcome by resending the original request with its action ID, idempotency key and payload.
